scope: HP/shield/lock-HP/death reference transitions for shield absorb, heal clamp, forced kill and damage commitment. Revive, prevent-death, caster-death cleanup ordering and special death events remain separate packets.

evidence.support: ordinary positive-heal clamp at MaxHP and ordinary death/terminal boundaries are frozen in the standard MVP.
modifier dirty-removal and callback deregistration are the caster-death cleanup boundary inputs.
LockHP, ForceKill, InitShield, RemoveShield, SetResilience, TriggerBreak/ResetStance and death-handler operation families are classified and structurally bound.

selected_model.damage_commit: Damage first consumes the current shield value, then reduces HP by the remainder; the transition returns absorbed-shield and hp-lost amounts separately.
selected_model.heal: Positive heal adds to HP and clamps at MaxHP; healing an already-dead entity is a no-op.
selected_model.shield: Shield apply adds deterministically; shield removal sets shield to zero at the modifier cleanup boundary.
selected_model.lock_hp: LockHP blocks HP changes from damage and blocks forced kill; healing and shield transitions remain allowed unless a later packet says otherwise.
selected_model.force_kill: ForceKill sets HP to zero and alive=false at the next primitive commit boundary unless HP is locked.
selected_model.death: alive becomes false exactly when HP reaches zero; the caster-death modifier cleanup (callback deregistration and property-contribution removal) uses PRIM-MODIFIER-001 dirty-removal at the same lifecycle boundary.
selected_model.ordering: All survival writes commit before the following sibling operation and before the next queued event under KERNEL-EVENT-001.

unsupported_cases: death event ordering for bosses and summons
special shield stacking policies beyond additive shield value
toughness/break state transitions beyond PRIM-DAMAGE-001 amount formulas
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_damage_survival_reference.py proves shield-before-HP absorption, heal clamp, lock-HP damage/force-kill blocking, and force-kill death transition.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement immutable SurvivalState transitions with exact Decimal arithmetic and explicit shield-absorb ordering. Never let locked HP drop from damage; never delete callbacks implicitly at death.
